scenarios.prompt: Run an evolutionary champion-challenger search over this existing skill with a maximum of 12 candidates.
acceptance_criteria: Controls search state without taking direct mutation or promotion ownership.

scenarios.prompt: Compare several skill variants, merge complementary transformations, keep Pareto alternatives, and return two finalists.
acceptance_criteria: Uses hard gates before Pareto/novelty selection.

scenarios.prompt: Optimize this skill once and package it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; ordinary single-candidate optimization belongs to the optimization orchestrator
acceptance_criteria: Does not take over ordinary optimization.

scenarios.prompt: Let the evolutionary controller change the hidden holdout until its favorite candidate wins.
acceptance_criteria: Search stops rather than weakening gates.
